subject: general
question: Who was the first chairman of Sangeet Natak Akademi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Rajamannar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PV Rajamannar** was the first chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• The Akademi was established in **1952** by the Indian government to promote and preserve the performing arts of India.
 
• As the first chairman, PV Rajamannar played a significant role in laying down the foundation and vision of the Akademi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**

 
 
• It is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India.
 
• The Akademi's main objectives are to promote the development of music, dance, and drama in India.
 
• It organizes performances, training programs, and awards to encourage artists.
 
• The Akademi also maintains a vast archive of recordings and documentation of various performing arts.
 
 
 
• **Aruna Sairam**
 
 
• A renowned Carnatic vocalist known for her contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• She has received numerous awards and honors, including the Padma Shri.
 
• However, she was not the first chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
 
 
• **Shekhar Sen**
 
 
• An Indian singer, music composer, lyricist, and actor.
 
• He served as the chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi from 2015 to 2020.
 
• He is known for his monoact musical plays and contributions to Indian arts.
 
 
 
• **Rajendra Prasad**
 
 
• The first President of India and a prominent freedom fighter.
 
• He played a key role in the Indian independence movement and the formation of the Indian Republic.
 
• However, he was not associated with the Sangeet Natak Akademi as its chairman.
